note: Subject texts of the Cultists of the Ancient Ones (bead pulp_wars-mch9.14, docs/art/factions/CULT.md). The faction has fixed colours and no owner colour: the lodge wears midnight indigo cloth with pale cream wax and paper, warm brass and one accent, a bright green flame; the summoned are rubbery deep-sea teal with cream bellies and pale yellow eyes, and their colours are named here, never in the faction fragment. The Initiate, the Horror, the Herald and City 1 are the lines of the direction's first sample; the other lines are drafts from its roster table for the batches (bead pulp_wars-mch9.15) and have not been generated.

subjects.UNIT:CULT:FIGHTER: Subject: Initiate, a chunky cute small secret-society novice with a huge round head about half of the figure's height and a tiny round body lost in a robe too big for it: a tall pointed midnight indigo hood whose tip flops over to one side, the face hidden in the hood's dark opening except two big round cream-white eyes, a long bell-shaped midnight indigo robe with a neat round hem down to the ground and sleeves too long for the arms, a fat pale cream wax candle with a small bright green flame held up in one hand, a sheaf of pale cream paper pamphlets tucked under the other arm, a small brass badge on the chest, pale cream slippers peeking out under the hem; no weapon, no staff, no beard, no skull; simple shapes and very few details.
subjects.UNIT:CULT:HORROR: Subject: Horror, a chunky cute round rubbery monster, clearly bigger than a soldier, a ball on legs: one big round smooth deep-sea teal body with a pale cream belly, standing on four short thick teal tentacles with pale cream suckers, a very wide happy grin full of small blunt cream teeth, two big round googly pale yellow eyes of different sizes with black pupils, a brass spiked collar round its middle with a short brass chain trailing behind; no arms, no clothes, no hood, no cloth, no horns, no claws; the tentacle feet are the lowest thing in the image; clearly a silly friendly monster, not scary; simple shapes and very few details.
subjects.UNIT:CULT:HERALD: Subject: Herald, a chunky cute towering herald, a giant much taller than a normal soldier and narrow, filling the whole height of the image: a tall tapering bell-shaped robe of midnight indigo cloth sprinkled with a few small pale cream stars, reaching the ground with a neat round hem, long empty hanging sleeves, a brass collar ring, and in place of a head one huge round pale yellow eye with a black pupil under a crown of five short thick curling deep-sea teal tentacles with pale cream suckers; no face, no mouth, no hands, no feet, no weapon; the robe's hem is the lowest thing in the image; pompous and silly, not scary; simple shapes and very few details.
subjects.UNIT:CULT:GUARD: Subject: Idol Bearer, a chunky cute stout wide secret-society member, the widest and squarest of its kind: a short midnight indigo hood squashed flat on top, the face hidden in the hood's dark opening except two big round cream-white eyes, a wide bell-shaped midnight indigo robe with a neat round hem down to the ground, pale cream slippers; both arms straight up holding one squat grinning pale grey stone idol with two small bright green eyes over its head, the idol as big as the head under it, like two heads stacked; one figure only; no weapon, no staff, no beard, no skull; simple shapes and very few details.
subjects.UNIT:CULT:RAIDER: Subject: Familiar, a chunky cute fat toad-cat, a small low wide animal in mid-hop with no robe and no clothes: a round squat body with a smooth indigo-blue hide and a pale cream belly, short cat ears, two stubby little bat wings, one big round cream eye and one small one, a wide mouth, four short legs, a brass collar with a small round brass bell; wider than it is tall; the feet are the lowest thing in the image; clearly a silly pet, not scary; simple shapes and very few details.
subjects.UNIT:CULT:MARKSMAN: Subject: Hexer, a chunky cute small secret-society scholar with a huge round head about half of the figure's height: a tall pointed midnight indigo hood whose tip curls over like a question mark, big round brass spectacles on the hood over two round cream-white eyes, the face hidden in the hood's dark opening, a bell-shaped midnight indigo robe with a neat round hem down to the ground, pale cream slippers; an open pale cream book held upside down in one hand, the other hand thrown forward with one small bright green squiggle of light leaving it; no weapon, no staff, no beard, no skull; simple shapes and very few details.
subjects.UNIT:CULT:CAPTAIN: Subject: Summoner, a chunky cute tall thin secret-society master, the tallest and thinnest of its kind: a very tall straight pointed midnight indigo hat-hood that reaches the top of the image, the face hidden in the hood's dark opening except two big round cream-white eyes, a long narrow midnight indigo robe with a neat round hem down to the ground, a long pale cream stole round the neck with one small eye-in-a-spiral sign on it, pale cream slippers; a small brass hand bell raised in one hand and a looped brass chain hanging from the other; no weapon, no staff, no beard, no skull; simple shapes and very few details.
subjects.UNIT:CULT:CATAPULT: Subject: Stargazer, a chunky cute big brass telescope on a wooden tripod with its small astronomer: a fat polished brass telescope tube pointing up and to the right on three weathered grey-brown wooden legs, and one small secret-society member in a midnight indigo robe bent to its eyepiece, wearing a floppy midnight indigo nightcap with small pale cream stars and a cream pompom, a pale cream star chart trailing on the ground behind; the telescope is bigger than the figure; no weapon, no staff, no beard, no skull; simple shapes and very few details.
subjects.UNIT:CULT:KNIGHT: Subject: Caller, a chunky cute stout secret-society diver: a big round polished brass diving helmet with one round porthole glowing bright green in place of a head, a bell-shaped midnight indigo robe darker and wet at its neat round hem, both hands holding one huge pale cream conch shell horn up to the helmet, the horn as big as the body, pale cream slippers; no face, no weapon, no staff, no beard, no skull; simple shapes and very few details.
subjects.UNIT:CULT:SWORDSMAN: Subject: Chosen, a chunky cute burly square secret-society champion with big broad shoulders: a short pointed midnight indigo hood thrown back, the face hidden in the hood's dark opening except two big round cream-white eyes, a short wide midnight indigo robe with a neat round hem, a broad pale cream sash across the chest with one round brass medal, pale cream slippers; one huge polished brass ceremonial cleaver held low in one hand, the other arm raised straight up with one finger pointing at the sky; no sword, no staff, no beard, no skull, no lettering; simple shapes and very few details.
subjects.UNIT:CULT:JUGGERNAUT: Subject: Thing in the Cellar, a chunky cute huge wide heap of a monster, a mound wider than it is tall: many fat rubbery deep-sea teal tentacles with pale cream suckers piled up and curling outward, many friendly round pale yellow eyes of different sizes with black pupils all over it, a broken weathered grey-brown wooden trapdoor round its middle like a collar, one tiny cream-and-indigo striped party hat on top; no legs, no arms, no robe, no hood, no cloth, no claws, no teeth; the lowest tentacles are the lowest thing in the image; clearly a silly friendly monster, not scary; simple shapes and very few details.
subjects.UNIT:CULT:TENTACLE: Subject: Tentacle, one chunky cute thick rubbery deep-sea teal tentacle rising straight up from the bottom edge of the image and curled over at the top as if to slap, a row of round pale cream suckers down its inner side, one round pale yellow eye with a black pupil at its tip; nothing else: no body, no hole, no water, no ground, no cloth; the cut base of the tentacle is the lowest thing in the image; silly, not scary; simple shapes and very few details.
subjects.CITY:CULT:1/CALM: Subject: a small level-1 town: one fat little meeting hall with pale cream-grey weatherboard walls on a low pale grey stone footing, a steep midnight indigo shingle roof ending in a bent crooked point, a small brass dome with a little brass telescope poking out of the roof ridge, one round window glowing green and a small green lamp over the door, and two tall narrow houses with the same cream walls and bent pointed indigo roofs pressed against its sides; wide and chunky, filling the whole width of the image. Buildings only.
